items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings held in a state of torment according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the relevant groups.
Those groups are located among thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings in those locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not specified here.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
